supersedes.scope: Both recorded PASS for R1, R6, R9 and R11 on 6dace45a; the independent re-review disproved those self-assessments. History is retained unchanged; this receipt is authoritative for those items.

findings.closure: Thought page scopes accept only the summary contract; detail-shaped increments invalidate the list scope instead of merging, and rebase no longer inherits cache from stale scopes, so same-watermark recovery no longer produces a false conflict. Equal-version genuine conflicts still raise SYNC_ENTITY_VERSION_CONFLICT.
Trash expansion resolves legacy parent ownership against every visible candidate parent identity; ambiguous same-ID identities expand nothing.
Admission read, reservation and settlement handoff share one account-day serial boundary; in-flight reads can no longer be discarded while a stale read rebuilds state from zero.

A call that has started persisting moves immediately from in-flight to recorded, and commit becomes idempotent, so one call consumes exactly one unit of quota across the real write-then-commit window.

Unconditional server-side rebase was removed; recovery now depends only on the state layer's actually invalidated scope keys, so a filter change that does not invalidate the open detail scope no longer re-reads it.
Key sync callbacks use named structural types and the v1/v2 status consumer is an exhaustive switch with assertNever; dropping the record-error branch now fails typecheck with TS2345.
